provenance: Hand-authored from each vendor's published list pricing on the asOf date. NOT fetched from any live registry and NOT machine-verified — a model reading a pricing page cannot be trusted with numbers that gate spend. Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens, matching gateway's ModelPrice shape exactly so no unit conversion happens anywhere. ROUND TOWARD OVER-CHARGING when a rate is ambiguous: a price that is slightly high makes a budget breaker fire early, which is safe; a price that is low or missing makes it never fire, which is the defect W12-11 exists to remove. Enterprise and negotiated rates differ from list — those users override per provider rather than editing this file. Staleness is surfaced, never silent: see STALE_AFTER_DAYS in gateway-model-port/pricing.ts.

notes.copilot: Deliberately absent. GitHub Copilot is a flat-fee subscription with no public per-token price, so copilot.ts defaults to LOCAL_COST_TABLE and metering it at $0 is HONEST rather than a gap — the user already paid a fixed amount. Do not add invented per-token rates here to make it look complete.
notes.local: ollama / lm-studio / any self-hosted oai-compat endpoint are genuinely $0 per token — the user owns the hardware. They are absent for the same reason copilot is, and LOCAL_COST_TABLE remains correct for them.
notes.cacheAndBatch: Cache-read, cache-write and batch tiers are NOT modelled. Every such tier is CHEAPER than the standard rate, so charging the standard rate over-reports, which is the safe direction. Recorded here so the omission is a known simplification rather than an oversight.
